channel.title: Notchy blog
channel.description: Guides for Notchy, the Mac app that lives in the notch.

item.title: Copy text from the screen on a Mac
item.description: Copy text from the Mac screen when the words are not selectable. Notchy reads the type that is on the screen, from the notch.

item.title: Dynamic Island for Mac
item.description: Dynamic Island for Mac is what people type when they want the MacBook notch to act like the iPhone island. That is a different job from Notchy.

item.title: A NotchNook alternative
item.description: A NotchNook alternative only helps if you wanted a different job. NotchNook is music, files, and a calendar. Notchy is the screenshot and the recording.

item.title: Scrolling screenshot on a Mac
item.description: A scrolling screenshot is one long image of a page that does not fit on the Mac screen. Notchy's Scroll button is that shot.

item.title: What is the MacBook notch for?
item.description: The MacBook notch is the camera housing at the top of the screen. It is not a button until an app makes it one.

item.title: How to record your Mac screen
item.description: Shift Command 5 opens the Mac's own screen recorder. Notchy records from the notch, with a timer and Stop.

item.title: A focus timer on the Mac
item.description: A focus timer on the Mac can sit in the notch. Notchy's starts at 25 minutes and counts down in the panel.

item.title: What else lives in the notch
item.description: NotchNook, Alcove and Boring Notch already use the Mac notch. They are mostly music, files and a calendar. Notchy is the glow, the shot and the recording.

item.title: Music, a file tray, or a capture
item.description: Most notch apps are a now-playing control and a place to drop files. Notchy is for taking the screen and recording it from that same spot.

item.title: The Mac already takes the shot
item.description: Shift Command 3, 4 and 5 are still the Mac's own screenshot keys. Notchy adds the notch, a scrolling shot, and a recording beside them.

item.title: Where a screenshot goes
item.description: After a screenshot, the panel can say it was saved to the Desktop and offer Show in Finder.

item.title: Tools in the notch panel
item.description: Focus timer, drop shelf, copy text, Scan QR, color picker, keep awake, world clock, and three optional tools.

item.title: Full-screen apps and the glow
item.description: In a full-screen app the glow stays off. Only a click opens the panel.

item.title: Keyboard shortcuts for the notch
item.description: Control Option Command 3, 4 and 7 take screenshots. 5 and 6 start and stop recordings.

item.title: Record the screen from the notch
item.description: Record the whole screen or an area from the notch. A timer runs until you stop.

item.title: Screenshots from the notch
item.description: Notchy takes a screenshot of the whole screen, an area, or a long scrolling page, from the notch or with a shortcut.

item.title: Open the panel from the notch
item.description: Rest the pointer on the notch, or click it, and the panel drops down.

item.title: The glow around the notch
item.description: A soft light appears around the notch as the pointer gets near, and it gets brighter the closer it gets.

item.title: What is Notchy?
item.description: Notchy is a Mac app that turns the notch at the top of the screen into a place for shortcuts, screenshots, recording and a few tools.
